title.en: A changed plan can have a specific impact
title.zh: 改了约定，影响可以说具体

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创场景：虚构的共同手工活动改了开始时间，却没有通知一位参与者，让其白等。你可以看重“我没通知，让你白等了，很抱歉”，也仍想知道谁负责通知、怎样补救。承认影响、明确责任和提出行动可以同时出现，不必从五组里选唯一语言。更看重歉意，不等于要求对方表现得比你更难过；是否继续活动仍是另一项决定。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a fictional craft session changes its start time without telling one participant, who waits unnecessarily. You may value “I did not tell you; I am sorry you were left waiting” and still want to discuss notification duties or repair. Recognition, responsibility and action can coexist without selecting one language. Valuing regret does not require the other person to appear more distressed than you, and continuing the activity is a separate decision.

title.en: Name one need without turning it into a test
title.zh: 说出一项需要，不把它变成考验

paragraphs.zh: 私人草稿可分别写“我希望被承认的影响”“我尚不清楚的经过”和“我愿意讨论的下一步”。例如，空等的影响可以说清，改变时间的全部原因仍可未知。接收偏好不会自动回答对方为什么这样做；没有需要讨论的下一步，也可以到此结束。
paragraphs.en: On a private draft, separate “the impact I want acknowledged,” “what I do not yet know about events” and “a next step I would discuss.” The effect of waiting can be clear while reasons for the timing change remain unknown. A receiving preference supplies no motive, and the draft can finish without another discussion.

paragraphs.zh: 以上是原创偏好说明，不是对真实事件、真诚或修复效果的核验。五组各四题，完整回答才显示各自的重视程度均分；NA不填补，全部五份指南仍可读。不按最高项派型或用均分要求原谅。可以只阅读或写不发送的草稿，分享公开指南无需公开回答、分数或他人经历。
paragraphs.en: These original preference examples verify neither an actual event, sincerity nor a repair outcome. Each of five groups needs four ratings for its separate importance mean; NA is not filled, and all five complete guides remain readable. There is no highest-mean type or score requiring forgiveness. Reading or drafting an unsent note is enough; sharing the public guide requires no answers, scores or another person’s experiences.

title.zh: 更正一句关于你的不实说法

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创场景：虚构的活动说明把你未曾答应的任务列在你名下，编辑说“是大家沟通不好”，却没指出自己把未确认信息当成定稿。你可以看重其说明这一具体步骤，同时保留对其他环节的未知。责任明确不等于一人承担所有问题，也不等于已经更正内容。问卷只问你有多重视这种承认，不核定实际责任或诚信。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a fictional activity notice assigns you a task you never accepted. Its editor says “communication was poor” without identifying their use of unconfirmed information as final. You may value acknowledgment of that step while leaving other events uncertain. Specific ownership does not assign every problem to one person or establish that the notice was corrected. The questionnaire concerns valuing this acknowledgment, without determining actual responsibility or honesty.

title.en: Separate an action, an impact and an unresolved fact
title.zh: 分开行为、影响与未确认事实

paragraphs.zh: 可以把“你总是不负责”改写为“我希望说明的是，哪一项未确认的信息被写进定稿”。另列仍有争议的事实，不把请求写成人格审判。若只想理解自己的接收偏好，用虚构说明练习即可，不需要调查任何人、公开更正或恢复联系。
paragraphs.en: Replace “you are always irresponsible” with “the point I want identified is which unconfirmed detail entered the final notice.” List disputed facts separately rather than turn a request into a character verdict. A fictional notice is enough for exploring your receiving preference, without investigating someone, publishing a correction or renewing contact.

paragraphs.zh: 以上是原创偏好说明，不是对真实事件、真诚或修复效果的核验。五组各四题，完整回答才显示各自的重视程度均分；NA不填补，全部五份指南仍可读。不按最高项派型或用均分要求原谅。可以只阅读或写不发送的草稿，分享公开指南无需公开回答、分数或他人经历。

title.en: A borrowed object has been damaged
title.zh: 借出的物品被损坏之后

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创场景：虚构的借阅中，一本书的封面被弄坏。接收者可能希望先了解可修复的范围，而不想收到另一种版本；道歉者也可以说明目前能承担什么。补救针对仍存在的影响，和承认已经做过什么、计划以后怎样借用不同。一个被提出但尚未接受的办法仍是提议，不能当成事情已经处理好或已获得原谅。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, the cover of a borrowed book is damaged. Its owner may want to understand repair options instead of receiving another edition, while the borrower can explain what is currently feasible. Repair addresses a remaining consequence, separately from owning an action or planning future borrowing. A proposal not yet accepted remains a proposal, without establishing that matters are settled or forgiveness has been granted.

title.zh: 只选一项仍能处理的影响

paragraphs.zh: 在虚构草稿里列“仍有的影响”“一种可能行动”和“行动前需确认的条件”。同一行动可以暂不可行，也可以不被接收者接受。不要把重视补救写成一定要收礼、同意某个报价或立即翻篇；均分不是损失估算，也不替双方确认方案。
paragraphs.en: For a fictional draft, list a remaining consequence, one possible action and a condition needing confirmation first. The action may be infeasible now or unwanted by the recipient. Valuing repair requires no gift, accepted quotation or immediate closure. A mean estimates no loss and confirms no agreement.

paragraphs.zh: 以上是原创偏好说明，不是对真实事件、真诚或修复效果的核验。五组各四题，完整回答才显示各自的重视程度均分；NA不填补，全部五份指南仍可读。不按最高项派型或用均分要求原谅。可以只阅读或写不发送的草稿，分享公开指南无需公开回答、分数或他人经历。

title.en: A missed promise needs a usable next arrangement
title.zh: 承诺落空之后，需要能用的下一次安排

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创场景：虚构的共同任务里，对方答应帮忙后才发现日期冲突。其说“下次答应前先核对日期”，是一项计划；下次真的核对并说明能否承担，才是另一条可观察信息。你可以重视具体计划，也认为当前需要备用安排。重视计划不意味着有义务继续等候，反复答题后的偏好均分变化也不能证明对方已经改变。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, someone accepts a fictional shared task before noticing a date clash. “Next time I will check before agreeing” is a plan; actually checking and explaining availability on another occasion is a separate observation. You may value a specific plan and still need a backup now. Valuing plans creates no obligation to wait, and changed preference means after retaking establish no change in someone else’s behaviour.

title.en: Separate a plan, a limit and a review point
title.zh: 分开计划、限制与回看时点

paragraphs.zh: 可写“下次相关情境是什么”“拟采取哪一步”和“什么仍不可保证”。例如，核对日期不能保证以后再无意外。草稿不需要设监督任务、索取日程权限或安排真实考验；你也可以认为这个改变提议没有回应自己的需要。
paragraphs.en: Draft the next relevant situation, the proposed step and what remains unguaranteed. Checking a date cannot prevent every later disruption. The draft needs no monitoring task, calendar access or real-life test, and you may decide that the proposed change does not address your need.

title.en: A practical correction does not decide the relationship
title.zh: 实际更正不替关系作决定

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创场景：虚构的错误活动说明已经被更正，受到影响的人认可更正，却不想讨论原谅，也不想参加下一次活动。认可行动、个人的原谅体验和继续交往可以分别决定。“现在不谈”不代表更正无效，更正也不让道歉者获得再次追问的资格。这个主题的均分只记录接收偏好，不给任何一方规定该怎样结束关系或何时恢复信任。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, an inaccurate activity notice has been corrected. The affected person appreciates the correction but wants neither a forgiveness discussion nor another activity. Recognising an action, experiencing forgiveness and continuing contact can be separate decisions. “Not discussing it now” does not invalidate a correction, and correcting creates no entitlement to keep asking. This mean records a receiving preference without prescribing closure or restored trust.

title.en: Choose whether there is anything you want to say
title.zh: 先决定自己是否想说什么

paragraphs.zh: 可以只在私人纸页选一项：“无需回应”“需要时间”“只处理实际事务”或“愿意谈一部分”，也可不选。再检查是否把选择误写成对道歉者的保证。重视被询问，不等于欠一个肯定回答；不想被询问，也不证明记仇或不宽容。
paragraphs.en: Privately consider no response, more time, practical matters only or a limited conversation, or leave the choice open. Check whether a choice accidentally became a promise to the person apologising. Valuing a request creates no debt of a positive answer; not wanting the question establishes neither resentment nor intolerance.

paragraphs.zh: 以上是原创偏好说明，不是对真实事件、真诚或修复效果的核验。五组各四题，完整回答才显示各自的重视程度均分；NA不填补，全部五份指南仍可读。不按最高项派型或用均分要求原谅。可以只阅读或写不发送的草稿，分享公开指南无需公开回答、分数或他人经历。
